name: Bugatti
look: Pure black, monumental uppercase display with wide tracking, transparent outlined pill CTAs, photography as the only depth.

hero.title: ARCHE
hero.sub: A sixteen-cylinder quad-turbo hyper sports car, hand-assembled in Molsheim. Forty examples. All accounted for.

features.title: SIXTEEN CYLINDERS
features.sub: An engine architecture that exists nowhere else, because nobody else has been asked to build one.

items.title: W16 QUAD-TURBO
items.body: Eight litres, four turbochargers, 1,600 PS. Assembled by hand over six days by a team of four.

items.title: SIXTY LITRES PER MINUTE
items.body: The cooling system moves enough water to empty a domestic bath in ninety seconds.

items.title: ACTIVE AERODYNAMICS
items.body: A rear wing that serves as spoiler, air brake and stabiliser, deploying in under four tenths of a second.

items.title: CARBON MONOCOQUE
items.body: A single-piece passenger cell with a torsional rigidity of 50,000 Nm per degree.

items.title: SIX MONTHS
items.body: The build time for one car, from the first component to the final road test on the Alsace roads.

items.title: FORTY EXAMPLES
items.body: The production run in full. Each is recorded, numbered, and never repeated in specification.

showcases.title: MOLSHEIM SINCE 1909
showcases.body: The Atelier occupies the same grounds it has since the marque was founded. Every car built here has passed through the same courtyard, and every owner is invited to walk it before delivery.
points: The original grounds, continuously in use
Four technicians per car, start to finish

showcases.title: NO SPECIFICATION IS REPEATED
showcases.body: A commission begins with two days in Molsheim. Paint is developed to a physical reference, leather is chosen from the hide, and the finished specification is retired the moment the car leaves.
points: Paint developed to a physical reference

gallery.title: GALLERY
gallery.sub: Photographed in Molsheim and on the Route des Crêtes.

testimonial.quote: They asked what I wanted the car to sound like at three thousand revolutions, and then they went away and did it. I have never been asked that question by anyone else.
testimonial.name: Isabelle Rousseau

pricing.title: OWNERSHIP
pricing.sub: Forty examples. Enquiries are handled directly by Molsheim.

items.a: Directly by Molsheim rather than through a dealer network. The first conversation is with the commission team, and it establishes what you want from the car before any figure is discussed.
Six months for Arche and Arche Sport from the confirmation of specification. A Solitaire commission runs to approximately eighteen months.
Ten years of scheduled servicing is included, performed by a travelling technician at an address of your choosing anywhere in Europe.

items.q: Can the car be driven on the road?
items.a: It is homologated for road use in the European Union, the United Kingdom, Switzerland and the United States. Top speed is limited to 380 km/h unless the second key is fitted.

cta.title: ENQUIRE
cta.sub: Forty examples. Enquiries handled directly by Molsheim.

notes: Pure black canvas with white type. There is no light mode in this system and no card surface brighter than #141414.
Every display headline is uppercase with 2–4px of positive tracking. Body copy stays sentence case at normal tracking — the contrast between the two is the whole voice.
There is no accent colour. The single non-monochrome value is a desaturated ice-blue used on inline anchor links, and even that appears rarely.
The primary CTA is a transparent pill with a 1px white outline. A filled button would break the restraint the rest of the system depends on.
Section rhythm runs to 120px — longer than most marketing sites, because the pages are mostly photography with very little text.
